This episode from September 2020 features Reed Hastings, the co-founder and CEO of Netflix, in conversation with Ben Horowitz, co-founder of A16C.
They talk about how Reed built Netflix, his management philosophy, lessons learned, and the tactics he used to instill a culture of innovation across the company.
as it expanded globally.
